hooks.command:
bash -c '
FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"
if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "plugins/[^/]+/(skills|hooks)/"; then
  PLUGIN=$(echo "$FILE" | sed "s|.*/plugins/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|")
  PLUGIN_JSON="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/plugins/$PLUGIN/.claude-plugin/plugin.json"
  CURRENT=$(bun -e "try{const p=JSON.parse(require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"$PLUGIN_JSON\",\"utf8\"));console.log(p.version||\"none\")}catch{console.log(\"missing\")}" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "[clogins] Edited $PLUGIN plugin source (version: $CURRENT). Bump version in plugins/$PLUGIN/.claude-plugin/plugin.json before committing."
fi
'
